outputIntent: Make one thesis or question readable in two seconds through a single dominant editorial tension and disciplined short copy.
positioning: Not a product ad, clickbait thumbnail, or fake magazine cover; it is an original cinematic editorial opener that makes one intellectual promise.
contentSchema: headline preferably under fourteen Chinese characters
one clean handoff into the next beat

layoutFamilies.topology: one physical metaphor occupies 58% of the frame; a quiet type field counters it; one tiny evidence accent links the two
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: cinematic medium-wide object portrait with controlled three-quarter depth
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one subject, one headline zone, optional one kicker, one evidence accent

layoutFamilies.topology: a material threshold or aperture reveals one resolved symbol; title sits inside deliberately empty architecture rather than on a card
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: quiet wide editorial frame with large negative space and restrained depth falloff
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one threshold, one symbol, one title zone, optional one kicker

physicalVisualSystem.material: tactile editorial still-life materials chosen from paper, glass, stone, fabric, or metal; one dominant material family per frame
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: large directional studio source with soft shadow transition, controlled highlight roll-off, and one deliberate signal reflection
physicalVisualSystem.color: two or three dominant colors total with one restrained semantic signal color
physicalVisualSystem.typography: oversized Chinese editorial headline with generous tracking and margin discipline; no masthead clutter

forbiddenElements: device mockup unless the topic requires it
black-stage red-line repetition without topic justification
qcAssertions: one message is readable in two seconds
subject does not block the title zone
frame reads as editorial thought rather than advertising
subject and type remain outside the subtitle-safe band
